This cocktail, so famous worldwide, is the homeland of Cuba, the country where it was born. The mojito is one of the most popular drinks in cocktails and since its invention, numerous versions have emerged that vary from the original.

"Preparación:\n"En un vaso tumbler agregar la menta, 1 oz de Goma, 1 oz jugo de limón natural, amanerar suavemente para no romper las hojas, llenar el vaso con hielo frappe, 2 oz de ron y revolver tratando de subir la menta y llenar con agua mineral con gas.

"Preparation:\n"In a tumbler glass add the mint, 1 oz of Goma, 1 oz of natural lemon juice, shake gently so as not to break the leaves, fill the glass with frappe ice, 2 oz of rum and stir trying to raise the mint and fill with water mineral with gas.
As a Cuban mojito riff, it has the essential mojito ingredients like mint, rum, and soda, but adds a tropical flavor with passion fruit pulp.
"Preparation:\n"In a shaker add 1 oz of natural lemon juice, 1 oz of Goma, 2 oz of rum, 1 Dash of Triple Sec. (one touch). Add 2 or 3 ice cubes, then mix (When the shaker is packed [cold]).

It is a classic cocktail, sweet, simple and refreshing, combining rum with lemon juice and sugar. This drink is known for its balance of sweet and sour flavors and rum. It is a versatile cocktail that can be enjoyed on a hot summer day.

"Preparation:\n"In a shaker add 1 oz of Goma, 1 oz of natural lemon juice, 2 oz of rum, 1 Dash of Triple Sec. (one touch). Add strawberry pulp, add basil and 3 or 4 ice, then mix (When the shaker is packed [cold]).

The Strawberry Daiquiri is a sweeter version of the traditional Daiquiri, but just as fresh and pleasant to drink with friends in a moment of relaxation. With this drink you will remember summer vacations and the feeling of being by the pool with this slushy delight perfect to beat the heat.

"Preparation:\n"In a shaker add 2 oz of pineapple pulp, 2 oz of coconut cream, 2 oz of rum, 1 oz of gum and 2/4 of ice cubes, then mix (When the shaker is packed [cold]).\nIn a glass add ¾ of ice, add the mixture to the glass and decorate with the misamplas
The piña colada is a classic tropical cocktail that combines the sweet and refreshing flavor of pineapple with the smoothness of coconut.

"Preparation:\n"First there you have to cool the glass with ice, rotating it for a few seconds to have a better cooling of it. Add 40 grams of blueberries, a dash of lemon, 1 dash of triple sec to the shaker. Then mash in the shaker, add 2 oz of vodka, add 3 to 4 ice cubes and shake. Remove the ice from the glass and add the double-strained cocktail, then decorate. (You can press the citrus to release a little oil and set it on fire for a second)
The classic and potent Cosmopolitan includes vodka, Triple Sec, cranberry juice and ice and is usually garnished with orange peel.
"Preparación:\n"Add 2 lemon wedges to the metal glass, macerate the lemon, add 3/4 frape ice, 2 oz of vodka, fill with ginger beer. Then add the decoration, in this case with some ginger slices
The Moscow Mule is rumored to have been invented in 1941 in New York. The only real link to Russia is that it has vodka, hence the Russian-sounding title.

"Preparation:\n"First there you have to cool the glass with ice, rotating it for a few seconds to have a better cooling of it. Add ½ ounce of coffee liqueur, ½ ounce of gum, 1 ounce of espresso to the shaker, add 1 1/2 ounces of vodka, add 3 to 4 ice cubes and shake. Remove the ice from the glass and add the cocktail to it, then decorate with coffee beans.

If you like coffee, a well-made Espresso Martini will satisfy many, if not all, senses. Just the sound and rhythm of ice chilling your drink as you shake it vigorously, the mesmerizing sight of the freshly poured drink slowly resting, the smell and taste of the perfect balance of sweet and dry where all the ingredients are enhanced by the vodka and finally the mouthfeel and the silky, thick foam on top.

"Preparation:\n"In a cocktail shaker add 1 oz of Goma, 1 oz of natural lemon juice, 2 oz of gin, add 3 ice cubes and shake very gently. Then add 3 ice cubes (3/4 of the glass) to a glass and transfer the contents of the shaker with the caterpillar strainer for better filtration, finish with Sparkling water, then decorate with a maraschino and a slice of lemon.
If you love gin, Tom Collins is for you. It is one of the most popular cocktails and at the same time very easy to make.

"Preparation:\n"In a glass add ice and stir to cool the glass, add a few pressed cloves to the orange slice and bury it in the orange, then add the orange to the glass, 2 oz of Geneva (Gin), add tonic water with the cocktail spoon so as not to break the bubbles, then decorate by adding some anise stars.
The Gin Tonic is a cocktail made with gin, tonic water and citrus peels. It is believed to have been first created in the 18th century by Dutch and British colonial companies.
